summary: Clearview Facility Services will clean the inside and outside of every window at Banyan Tree Dental Clinic once a month, for Rs. 1,500 a visit, paid within seven days of each visit. The agreement runs for one year from the date both parties sign it, then ends without renewing. Either side can end it by giving fifteen days' written notice after the first three months, with no fee for ending early. Indian law applies, and the courts at Mysuru have jurisdiction.
